description: This file defines a scraper class 'FlavorsByLinbie' for extracting recipe data from the website flavorsbylinbie.com, including methods for retrieving author, title, category, total time, yields, ingredients, instructions, and description.

classes.name: FlavorsByLinbie
classes.description: A scraper class for flavorsbylinbie.com that extends AbstractScraper and provides methods to extract recipe details.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the target website.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the recipe author, first trying schema, then HTML link, then fallback to site name.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title from the page.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Gets the recipe category from schema or meta tag.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total preparation time from headings or paragraphs.

methods.name: _extract_time_from_servings_section
methods.description: Helper to extract prep or cook time from servings section.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Determines the number of servings or yield from the recipe.

methods.name: _get_servings_time_paragraph
methods.description: Retrieves the paragraph containing servings and time info.

methods.name: _slice_field
methods.description: Helper to extract specific field values from paragraphs.

methods.name: _normalize_time_phrase
methods.description: Normalizes time phrases for consistent parsing.

methods.name: _extract_time_from_paragraph
methods.description: Parses minutes from a paragraph given a label.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the image URL of the recipe.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts list of ingredients from the recipe page.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Provides a brief description of the recipe.
